# Umeed Care Center

> Umeed Care Center is a home-visit orthotic and prosthetic service in Karachi, Pakistan, for patients of all ages. There is no walk-in outlet: a specialist comes to the patient's home anywhere in Karachi for assessment, measurement, trial fitting and follow-up. The first consultation is free. "Umeed" means hope.

## Quick facts

- Service: artificial limbs, braces, custom insoles and diabetic footwear
- Area: all of Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan (home visits only)
- Booking: WhatsApp or call +92 313 6422564
- Email: shahsahab022@gmail.com
- Languages: English and Urdu
- First consultation: free. Device price is given after assessment.
- Published Karachi price range for artificial legs (from other providers): below-knee PKR 80,000 to 350,000, above-knee PKR 150,000 to 600,000. Exact price depends on components.
- Website: https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100054410172615

## Services

- [Lower Limb Prosthetics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/lower-limb-prosthetics): below-knee and above-knee artificial legs
- [Upper Limb Prosthetics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/upper-limb-prosthetics): artificial hands and arms
- [Pediatric Orthotics and Prosthetics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/pediatric-orthotics-prosthetics): devices for growing children, clubfoot braces
- [Spinal Orthotics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/spinal-orthotics): back braces and scoliosis braces
- [Lower Limb Orthotics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/lower-limb-orthotics): AFO, KAFO and knee braces
- [Upper Limb Orthotics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/upper-limb-orthotics): wrist, elbow and hand splints
- [Custom Foot Orthotics](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/custom-foot-orthotics): custom insoles and arch supports
- [Diabetic Footwear](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/services/diabetic-footwear): therapeutic shoes and pressure-relief footwear

- [Clubfoot (CTEV) Braces and Denis Browne Shoes in Karachi](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/clubfoot-ctev-shoes-denis-browne-karachi): What a clubfoot brace is, why it is worn after casting, how Denis Browne shoes work and what parents in Karachi should know about fit and follow-up.
- [Artificial Leg Types in Karachi: Below-Knee, Above-Knee and Components](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/artificial-leg-types-karachi): Below-knee and above-knee artificial legs explained, with how sockets, knees and feet differ in cost and use, plus the typical price range in Karachi.
- [How the Artificial Leg Process Works: Steps and Timeline](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/artificial-leg-process-and-timeline-karachi): The steps from first assessment to walking with an artificial leg, what affects how long it takes and why several adjustment visits are normal.
- [Diabetic Foot Care: Therapeutic Shoes, Insoles and Offloading in Karachi](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/diabetic-foot-offloading-footwear-karachi): How therapeutic footwear and custom insoles protect a diabetic foot, which warning signs need a doctor, and what offloading boots are for.
- [AFO vs KAFO vs Knee Brace: Which Leg Brace Do You Need?](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/afo-vs-kafo-vs-knee-brace-karachi): A side-by-side guide to AFO, KAFO and knee braces: what each supports, which conditions they suit and how to tell which one applies to you.
- [Scoliosis Brace for Children in Karachi: How Bracing Works](https://umeedcarecenter.vercel.app/guides/scoliosis-brace-karachi): How a scoliosis brace works, who needs one, how many hours it is worn and what to do if a child finds it hard to wear.
